name: Peruvian Roast Chicken with Green Sauce
description: Garlicky, cumin-spiced chicken thighs with a creamy cilantro aji verde.
keto_swap: Naturally keto, serve with a side salad. Family: add roasted potatoes or rice.
steps: Heat oven to 425F. Mix minced garlic, cumin, paprika, soy sauce, oil and salt, rub all over the chicken.
Roast on a sheet pan (potatoes on a second pan for the family) 30 to 35 minutes until crisp and 175F inside.
Blend cilantro, jalapeno, mayo, lime juice and a pinch of salt into a green sauce.
Serve the chicken with the sauce spooned over.

name: Lomo Saltado (Peruvian Beef Stir-Fry)
description: Fast steak stir-fry with onions, tomatoes and a soy-vinegar sauce.
keto_swap: Keto: skip the fries and rice, serve over cauliflower rice. Family: add frozen fries and white rice.
steps: Slice steak into strips and season with salt, pepper and cumin. Cut onion and tomatoes into wedges.
Sear beef in a very hot skillet in two batches, 2 minutes each. Set aside.
Stir-fry onion and garlic 2 minutes, add tomatoes, soy sauce and vinegar, then return the beef for 1 minute.
Top with cilantro and serve over cauliflower rice, or rice and fries for the family.

name: Peruvian Chicken Skewers
description: Marinated chicken on skewers with spicy cilantro sauce. Grill or broil.
keto_swap: Naturally keto, serve with grilled veggies. Family: add rice or pita.
steps: Cube the chicken and marinate 10 minutes with garlic, cumin, paprika, vinegar and oil.
Thread onto skewers with zucchini chunks.
Grill or broil 4 to 5 minutes per side until cooked through.
Blend cilantro, sour cream, jalapeno and salt for the dipping sauce.

name: Chicken Teriyaki Bowls
description: Glazed chicken with steamed broccoli.
keto_swap: Keto: coconut aminos with garlic and ginger instead of bottled teriyaki, over cauliflower rice. Family: regular teriyaki sauce and white rice.
steps: Cube chicken and sear in a hot skillet 6 to 7 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Add garlic, ginger and the sauce (aminos for keto, bottled teriyaki for the family) and simmer 2 minutes until glossy.
Steam broccoli in the microwave 3 minutes.
Serve over cauliflower rice or white rice, topped with sesame seeds.

name: Sesame Ginger Salmon
description: Sheet-pan salmon with a quick soy-ginger glaze and green beans.
keto_swap: Naturally keto with coconut aminos. Family: add rice.
steps: Heat oven to 400F. Whisk soy sauce, ginger, garlic and sesame oil.
Put salmon and trimmed green beans on a lined sheet pan, spoon half the sauce over the salmon.
Bake 12 to 14 minutes until salmon flakes.
Drizzle with the rest of the sauce and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

name: Thai Basil Chicken
description: Spicy ground chicken stir-fry with garlic and basil. 20 minutes.
keto_swap: Keto: serve over cauliflower rice, skip sugar in the sauce. Family: jasmine rice and a fried egg on top.
steps: Brown the chicken in a hot wok or skillet, 6 minutes, breaking it up.
Add minced garlic, sliced peppers and pepper flakes, cook 3 minutes.
Stir in soy sauce and fish sauce, then fold in basil until wilted.
Serve over cauliflower rice or jasmine rice.

name: Thai Green Curry Chicken
description: Creamy coconut green curry with chicken and veggies.
keto_swap: Keto: use zucchini and broccoli, serve over cauliflower rice. Family: add jasmine rice and bamboo shoots.
steps: Cook curry paste in a pot for 1 minute, then whisk in the coconut milk.
Add sliced chicken and simmer 8 minutes.
Add zucchini and broccoli, cook 5 more minutes.
Finish with fish sauce and lime juice, serve over cauliflower rice or jasmine rice.

name: Korean Beef Bulgogi Bowls
description: Sweet-savory ground beef with sesame and green onions.
keto_swap: Keto: coconut aminos and a pinch of sweetener, serve over cauliflower rice with kimchi. Family: brown sugar in the sauce and white rice.
steps: Mix soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, ginger and pepper flakes (add brown sugar to the family portion).
Brown the beef in a skillet 7 to 8 minutes, drain, then add the sauce and simmer 3 minutes.
Slice cucumber and green onions.
Serve over cauliflower rice or white rice topped with cucumber and onions.

name: Garlic Shrimp & Veggie Stir-Fry
description: Ready in 15 minutes with frozen stir-fry veggies.
keto_swap: Keto: use low-carb veggies (broccoli, peppers, zucchini) and cauliflower rice. Family: add noodles or rice.
steps: Stir-fry broccoli and peppers in a hot skillet with a splash of water, 4 minutes. Remove.
Add garlic, ginger and shrimp, cook 3 minutes until pink.
Return the veggies, add soy sauce and sesame oil, toss 1 minute.
Serve over cauliflower rice or white rice.

name: Asian Chicken Lettuce Wraps
description: Crunchy, savory ground chicken in butter lettuce cups.
keto_swap: Keto: skip hoisin (use aminos and a splash of vinegar), no noodles. Family: hoisin sauce and crispy noodles on top.
steps: Brown the chicken with garlic and ginger, 7 minutes.
Stir in chopped water chestnuts, soy sauce, vinegar and sesame oil, cook 2 minutes (hoisin goes in the family portion).
Stir in green onions.
Spoon into lettuce cups and eat with your hands.

name: Kung Pao Chicken
description: Spicy, nutty chicken with peppers. Faster than takeout.
keto_swap: Keto: coconut aminos, no sugar, over cauliflower rice. Family: add a spoon of honey and serve with white rice.
steps: Cube chicken, season with salt and sear in a hot pan 5 to 6 minutes. Remove.
Cook peppers, zucchini, garlic and pepper flakes 4 minutes.
Add soy sauce, vinegar (and honey for the family portion), return chicken and peanuts, toss 2 minutes.
Serve over cauliflower rice or white rice.

name: Chicken Fried Rice / Cauliflower Fried Rice
description: Same pan, same sauce, two bases.
keto_swap: Keto: cauliflower rice instead of rice, skip peas and carrots. Family: day-old rice with peas and carrots.
steps: Shred the rotisserie chicken. Scramble eggs in a large skillet and set aside.
Cook garlic and the base in separate pans: cauliflower rice 5 minutes for keto; rice with peas and carrots 5 minutes for the family.
Stir in chicken, eggs and soy sauce.
Finish with sesame oil and green onions.

name: Vietnamese Pork Meatball Lettuce Wraps
description: Herby pork meatballs with cucumber and mint in lettuce.
keto_swap: Keto: wrap in lettuce, dip in fish sauce-lime. Family: add rice noodles or rice paper rolls.
steps: Mix pork with minced garlic, 1 tbsp fish sauce, green onions and pepper. Roll into small meatballs.
Pan-fry or bake at 425F for 12 to 15 minutes.
Mix lime juice and the rest of the fish sauce for dipping.
Serve in lettuce with cucumber and mint, noodles on the side for the family.

name: Chicken Lo Mein
description: Takeout noodles at home with chicken and cabbage.
steps: Boil noodles per the package and drain.
Sear sliced chicken in a large skillet, 6 minutes, with garlic.
Add coleslaw mix and peas and carrots, cook 3 minutes.
Toss in noodles, soy sauce, hoisin and sesame oil until hot.

name: Mongolian Beef
description: Tender, sticky flank steak with green onions.
keto_swap: Keto: coconut aminos, no brown sugar, over cauliflower rice. Family: brown sugar sauce over white rice.
steps: Slice steak thin against the grain.
Sear in a very hot pan in two batches, 2 minutes each. Remove.
Simmer garlic, ginger, soy sauce and a splash of water 2 minutes (add brown sugar for the family portion).
Return beef and green onions, toss 1 minute, finish with sesame oil.

name: Easy Chicken Pad Thai
description: Weeknight pad thai with a quick sauce.
steps: Soak rice noodles in hot water 8 minutes and drain.
Sear sliced chicken 6 minutes. Push aside and scramble the eggs in the pan.
Add noodles and pad thai sauce, toss 3 minutes.
Top with bean sprouts, green onions, peanuts and lime.

name: Easy Butter Chicken
description: Creamy tomato-spiced chicken, mild enough for kids.
keto_swap: Keto: serve over cauliflower rice. Family: basmati rice and naan.
steps: Melt butter and cook diced onion, garlic and ginger 4 minutes. Stir in garam masala for 30 seconds.
Add cubed chicken and tomato sauce, simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in cream and simmer 5 more minutes.
Serve over cauliflower rice, or rice and naan for the family.

name: Sheet-Pan Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Yogurt-marinated chicken roasted on a pan with a quick tomato sauce.
keto_swap: Keto: cauliflower rice. Family: naan and rice.
steps: Mix chicken with yogurt, half the garam masala, garlic and salt. Marinate while the oven heats to 425F.
Roast on a sheet pan with sliced onion 20 minutes.
Simmer tomato sauce, cream and the rest of the garam masala 8 minutes in a pot.
Pour sauce over the chicken and serve.

name: Palak Chicken (Spinach Curry)
description: Creamy spinach curry with tender chicken.
keto_swap: Keto: serve with cauliflower rice. Family: basmati rice or naan.
steps: Sear cubed chicken 5 minutes in a deep skillet. Remove.
Cook onion, garlic, ginger and garam masala 4 minutes.
Add spinach and a splash of water until wilted, then blend until smooth or leave chunky.
Return chicken, add cream, simmer 8 minutes.

name: Tandoori Chicken Thighs
description: Yogurt and spice marinated thighs, roasted until charred.
keto_swap: Keto: serve with a cucumber salad. Family: add rice and naan.
steps: Mix yogurt, spices, minced garlic, lemon juice and salt. Coat the chicken and marinate at least 10 minutes (or in the morning).
Roast on a rack-lined pan at 425F for 30 to 35 minutes.
Broil the last 2 minutes for char.
Serve with sliced cucumber.

name: Beef Keema
description: Spiced ground beef with peas. One pan.
keto_swap: Keto: leave out the peas and serve over cauliflower rice or wrapped in lettuce. Family: peas and basmati rice or naan.
steps: Brown the beef with diced onion, 8 minutes. Drain.
Add garlic, ginger, garam masala and tomato paste, cook 2 minutes.
Add a splash of water and simmer 8 minutes (peas go in the family portion for the last 3).
Serve over cauliflower rice or basmati.

name: Coconut Shrimp Curry
description: Fast curry with shrimp and spinach.
keto_swap: Keto: cauliflower rice. Family: basmati rice.
steps: Cook garlic, ginger and curry powder in a skillet 1 minute.
Add coconut milk and simmer 5 minutes.
Add shrimp, cook 4 minutes until pink, then stir in spinach until wilted.
Finish with lime juice and serve over cauliflower rice or basmati.

name: Chicken Souvlaki Bowls
description: Lemon-oregano chicken with cucumber salad and tzatziki.
keto_swap: Keto: skip pita, extra salad and feta. Family: pita and rice.
steps: Cube chicken and marinate 10 minutes with lemon juice, oregano, garlic and oil.
Grill or sear in a hot skillet 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until cooked through.
Chop cucumber and tomatoes, crumble feta.
Build bowls with chicken, salad and tzatziki, warm pita on the side for the family.

name: Greek Turkey Meatballs with Tzatziki
description: Baked turkey meatballs with spinach and feta.
keto_swap: Keto: skip breadcrumbs (almond flour), serve with salad. Family: pita and rice.
steps: Heat oven to 400F. Chop spinach and mix with turkey, feta, egg, almond flour, garlic, oregano and salt.
Roll into 20 meatballs and bake on a lined sheet 18 to 20 minutes.
Slice cucumber for a side salad.
Serve with tzatziki.

name: Lemon Herb Baked Cod with Tomatoes & Olives
description: One-pan fish dinner in under 30 minutes.
keto_swap: Naturally keto. Family: add couscous or crusty bread.
steps: Heat oven to 400F. Put cod in a baking dish with tomatoes, olives, garlic and oil.
Season with oregano, salt, pepper and lemon slices.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes until the fish flakes.
Squeeze lemon over the top and serve.

name: Feta Baked Shrimp
description: Shrimp baked in tomato sauce with melty feta.
keto_swap: Keto: serve with a green salad. Family: crusty bread or pasta.
steps: Heat oven to 400F. Spread marinara in a baking dish with minced garlic and oregano.
Nestle in the shrimp and top with crumbled feta.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes until shrimp are pink and feta is soft.
Serve with salad, bread for the family.

name: Chicken Shawarma Sheet Pan
description: Spiced chicken and onions with garlic yogurt sauce.
keto_swap: Keto: bowl with salad and garlic sauce. Family: warm pita.
steps: Heat oven to 425F. Toss chicken and sliced onions with oil, cumin, paprika, turmeric and salt.
Roast on a sheet pan 22 to 25 minutes.
Mix yogurt, minced garlic, lemon juice and salt for the sauce.
Slice the chicken and serve with the sauce and cucumber.

name: Beef Kofta Kebabs
description: Spiced beef skewers, grilled or broiled in minutes.
keto_swap: Keto: serve with salad and tzatziki. Family: pita and rice.
steps: Mix beef with grated onion, garlic, chopped parsley, cumin, cinnamon and salt.
Shape around skewers or into long ovals.
Grill or broil 4 to 5 minutes per side.
Serve with tzatziki and chopped cucumber and tomato salad.

name: Gyro-Style Beef Bowls
description: Seasoned ground beef with tzatziki and all the fixings.
keto_swap: Keto: over lettuce with feta and olives. Family: warm pita and rice.
steps: Brown beef with oregano, cumin, garlic and salt, 8 minutes. Drain.
Chop lettuce, tomatoes and red onion.
Build bowls with beef, veggies, feta and tzatziki.
Add warm pita for the family.

name: Baked Chicken Parmesan
description: Crispy baked cutlets under marinara and mozzarella.
keto_swap: Keto: crush pork rinds with parmesan for the coating, side of roasted broccoli. Family: panko and spaghetti.
steps: Heat oven to 425F. Slice breasts into thin cutlets, dip in egg, then crushed pork rinds with parmesan (panko for the family).
Bake on a rack-lined sheet 15 minutes.
Top with marinara and mozzarella, bake 8 more minutes.
Roast broccoli alongside, boil spaghetti for the family.

name: Chicken Piccata
description: Lemony caper butter sauce on pan-seared chicken.
keto_swap: Keto: skip flour or dredge lightly in almond flour, serve with zucchini noodles. Family: dredge in flour, serve over pasta.
steps: Slice breasts into thin cutlets, season and dredge lightly in almond flour.
Sear in butter and oil 4 minutes per side. Remove.
Add garlic, broth, lemon juice and capers, simmer 4 minutes, swirl in butter.
Return chicken and serve over zucchini noodles or spaghetti.

name: Italian Stuffed Peppers
description: Peppers filled with sausage, cheese and marinara.
keto_swap: Keto: fill with cauliflower rice instead of rice. Family: rice in the filling.
steps: Heat oven to 400F. Halve peppers and remove seeds.
Brown sausage with garlic, stir in marinara and cauliflower rice (rice for the family batch).
Fill the peppers, top with mozzarella.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes until tender.

name: Skillet Lasagna
description: All the flavor of lasagna in one pan, no layering.
keto_swap: Keto: zucchini slices instead of noodles in a smaller dish. Family: broken lasagna noodles cooked in the sauce.
steps: Brown beef with garlic, drain, stir in marinara.
Family pan: add broken noodles and 1 cup water, cover and simmer 15 minutes. Keto: layer zucchini slices in a small dish with the meat sauce.
Dollop ricotta over both and top with mozzarella.
Cover until melted, about 5 minutes.

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp Scampi
description: Ready in 15 minutes.
keto_swap: Keto: serve over zucchini noodles. Family: linguine.
steps: Boil linguine for the family. Spiralize zucchini for keto.
Melt butter, cook garlic and pepper flakes 1 minute, add shrimp and cook 3 minutes per side.
Add lemon juice and parsley.
Toss with noodles, or serve over sauteed zucchini noodles.

name: Caprese Chicken
description: Chicken topped with mozzarella, tomatoes and basil.
keto_swap: Naturally keto, serve with a green salad. Family: add pasta or garlic bread.
steps: Heat oven to 400F. Slice breasts into cutlets and sear in oil 3 minutes per side.
Top with tomato slices and mozzarella, bake 8 to 10 minutes.
Top with basil and balsamic glaze.
Serve with spinach salad, spaghetti for the family.

name: Zuppa Toscana
description: Creamy sausage and kale soup.
keto_swap: Keto: cauliflower florets instead of potatoes. Family: potatoes plus crusty bread.
steps: Brown sausage with onion and garlic in a large pot. Drain extra grease.
Add broth and cauliflower (and potatoes for the family pot), simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in kale and cream, simmer 5 minutes.
Serve with bread for the family.

name: Pesto Chicken Pasta
description: Easy pasta with pesto, chicken and tomatoes.
steps: Boil penne per the package and save a cup of pasta water.
Cook cubed chicken in oil 6 to 7 minutes, add halved tomatoes for the last 2 minutes.
Toss with pasta, pesto and a splash of pasta water.
Top with parmesan.

name: Chicken Enchilada Skillet
description: Enchilada flavors without rolling anything.
keto_swap: Keto: skip tortillas and beans, serve over cauliflower rice with avocado. Family: tortilla strips and rice.
steps: Saute sliced peppers in a skillet 4 minutes.
Add shredded chicken and enchilada sauce, simmer 5 minutes.
Top with cheese, cover until melted.
Serve over cauliflower rice with avocado and sour cream; chips and beans for the family.

name: Carne Asada Bowls
description: Lime-marinated steak sliced over rice or greens.
keto_swap: Keto: over romaine with guac and cheese. Family: rice, beans and tortillas.
steps: Marinate steak 10 minutes with lime juice, garlic, cumin and salt.
Sear in a very hot pan or grill 4 to 5 minutes per side. Rest 5 minutes.
Slice thin against the grain.
Build bowls on lettuce or rice with avocado, tomato and cheese.

name: Baja Shrimp Tacos
description: Spicy shrimp with cabbage slaw and lime crema.
keto_swap: Keto: in lettuce cups or cheese shells. Family: warm tortillas.
steps: Toss shrimp with chili powder, cumin and salt, then sear 2 to 3 minutes per side.
Mix coleslaw with lime juice and salt. Stir lime zest and juice into sour cream for the crema.
Slice avocado.
Fill lettuce cups or tortillas with shrimp, slaw, avocado and crema.

name: Chicken Tortilla Soup
description: Cozy, spicy soup that comes together fast.
keto_swap: Keto: top with cheese, avocado and sour cream, skip the chips and beans. Family: add beans, corn and tortilla chips.
steps: Saute diced onion and garlic in a pot 4 minutes with chili powder.
Add broth, enchilada sauce and tomatoes, simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in shredded chicken (and beans in the family portion).
Serve topped with cheese and avocado, chips for the family.

name: Cuban Mojo Chicken
description: Garlic-citrus chicken thighs. Marinate in the morning if you can.
keto_swap: Keto: serve with sauteed peppers and onions. Family: add black beans and rice.
steps: Mix orange juice, lime juice, minced garlic, cumin, oregano and salt. Marinate the chicken at least 10 minutes.
Roast at 425F on a sheet pan 30 to 35 minutes with sliced peppers and onion.
Boil rice and heat beans for the family.
Spoon pan juices over everything.

name: BBQ Chicken Sheet Pan
description: Sticky BBQ chicken with green beans.
keto_swap: Keto: sugar-free BBQ sauce, with green beans. Family: regular BBQ sauce and corn or potatoes.
steps: Heat oven to 425F. Toss green beans with oil and salt on one side of a sheet pan.
Season chicken, roast 20 minutes.
Brush with BBQ sauce (sugar-free for keto, regular for the family) and roast 10 more minutes.
Potatoes for the family go on a second pan, roasted the full 30 minutes.

name: Philly Cheesesteak Skillet
description: Beef, peppers, onions and provolone.
keto_swap: Keto: eat as a skillet or stuffed in bell peppers. Family: on toasted hoagie rolls.
steps: Cook sliced peppers and onion in a large skillet 6 minutes.
Add beef and garlic, cook 4 minutes.
Top with provolone, cover 1 minute until melted.
Pile onto toasted rolls for the family.

name: Cajun Shrimp & Sausage Skillet
description: Smoky sausage and shrimp with peppers.
keto_swap: Keto: over cauliflower rice. Family: white rice.
steps: Brown sliced sausage in a skillet 4 minutes, then add peppers, onion and garlic 5 minutes.
Add shrimp tossed in Cajun seasoning, cook 3 to 4 minutes.
Stir in butter.
Serve over cauliflower rice or white rice.

name: Garlic Butter Steak Bites
description: Seared sirloin cubes in garlic butter with green beans.
keto_swap: Naturally keto. Family: add mashed potatoes or rolls.
steps: Cube the steak, season with salt and pepper.
Sear in a very hot skillet in two batches, 2 to 3 minutes.
Lower heat, add butter and garlic for 1 minute and toss.
Steam green beans and serve alongside, with mashed potatoes for the family.

name: Grilled Chicken Caesar Salad
description: Big dinner salad with crispy parmesan.
keto_swap: Keto: skip croutons, extra parmesan. Family: croutons and garlic bread.
steps: Season chicken with salt, pepper and lemon juice and cook 6 minutes per side. Rest and slice.
Chop romaine and toss with dressing and parmesan.
Top with chicken.
Add croutons for the family.

name: Turkey Burger Bowls
description: All the burger toppings in a bowl.
keto_swap: Keto: lettuce base, no bun, mustard and mayo. Family: toasted buns and fries.
steps: Shape turkey into 4 patties and season with salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Cook 5 to 6 minutes per side to 165F.
Chop the toppings and build the bowls.
Serve family patties on buns with fries.

name: Tuna Salad Stuffed Avocados
description: No-cook dinner for hot nights.
keto_swap: Keto: stuffed in avocado halves. Family: tuna salad sandwiches.
steps: Drain tuna and mix with mayo, diced celery, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Halve avocados and remove pits.
Fill with the tuna salad.
Make sandwiches for the family.

name: Cheeseburger Pasta Skillet
description: Hamburger helper, but homemade.
steps: Brown beef with diced onion, drain.
Stir in tomato paste, broth and macaroni, cover and simmer 12 to 14 minutes, stirring.
Stir in cheddar until melted.
Top with chopped pickles.
